decision: Replace the scalar physical-MTP width ceiling with a profile-owned width/depth policy. The gfx1151 Qwen3.8 Q4_K_M production package preserves C1-C4/K1-K3 and admits explicit C8/K3; C5-C7 remain on AR. gfx1100 behavior is unchanged.

policy.serving_scope: explicit only; automatic_eligible=false; greedy_fast; context 1-128; output horizon 24; resident capacity 8

red_green.red: Ten policy tests failed under the scalar physical_max_requests=4 design because it could not represent an admitted C8 cell while rejecting C5-C7.
red_green.green: Capability, planner, adapter capacity, and execution now resolve exact profile-owned width/depth cells; 128 focused tests passed before the hardware packet.

full_prompt_suite.correctness_contract: mtp_self_exact plus generated-ID equality to true same-protocol AR

dynamic_lifecycle.sequence: physical C8/K3 -> cancel three rows -> C5 AR -> refill three rows -> physical C8/K3 -> cancel all but one survivor -> drain

production_profile_inheritance.basis: The width policy changes admission and ownership, not arithmetic. The full suite is generated-ID equal to AR, the lifecycle survivor is AR-equal, and the C8 target uses the exact package-owned Q6 row-8 primitive covered by the parent 216-row production-profile gate.

performance.protocol: OpenAI server barrier-to-last-completion wall time; full ten-prompt mtp-bench category suite; natural greedy output; 24-token horizon; one warmup per arm; true no-MTP AR baseline; candidate budget 3; resident capacity 8; cached builds required
performance.interpretation: C8 is an exact complete-wall gain overall and is independently consistent in sign with the prior same-host B5 suite. C5-C7 are not admitted. The diagnostic K0-arm rates at C5-C7 include forced static-eligibility setup and are not promoted as product routes. Mixed Japanese/English is slower in this run, so the retained C8 scope remains explicit rather than automatic.
